headings.usage: Use font-semibold or font-extrabold. Avoid Regular for headings.

body.usage: High legibility for data and text.

mono.usage: For email addresses, API keys, and logs.

rules: CRITICAL: DO NOT use Inter for headings.
Headings must be strictly Left Aligned.
Use generous line-height for body text (leading-7 or leading-8).

usage_rules: Primary CTA (Start Campaign, Upgrade) MUST use 'Signal Orange' (#EA580C) or 'Electric Blue' (#2563EB).
Dashboard graphs should use a monochrome scale with one accent color.
Avoid gradients. Use solid, flat colors.
Text on colored backgrounds must be white (#FFFFFF).

navigation.style: Sidebar or Topbar with minimal items.
navigation.alignment: Left aligned logo, right aligned profile.

inputs.height: h-10 or h-12 for better touch targets

toasts.style: clean white toast with black text

charts.style: Minimal axes, tooltip enabled, monochromatic bars with active state highlight.

motion.micro_interactions: Button hover lift, input focus ring expansion.

texture.noise: Optional subtle noise overlay on the sidebar or hero background to reduce digital flatness.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure 4.5:1 contrast ratio for normal text.
accessibility.focus: Visible focus rings on all interactive elements.
accessibility.attributes: All interactive elements must have data-testid.

microcopy.error: We couldn't connect to that account.
microcopy.empty_state: No campaigns yet. Start your first rotation.

placeholders.logo: Use a simple text logo 'ROTATION' in Manrope-ExtraBold.

instructions_to_main_agent: INSTALL FONTS: You MUST install '@fontsource/manrope', '@fontsource/public-sans', and '@fontsource/jetbrains-mono' immediately.
THEME SETUP: Ensure tailwind.config.js extends the font family to include these fonts.
LAYOUT: Use the 'Bento Grid' for the dashboard. Do not create a generic table layout.
COMPONENTS: Use Shadcn components for complex interactions (Dialog, Dropdown, Form). Customize them to remove the default rounded-xl and use rounded-md.
CHARTS: Use Recharts for the analytics. Keep them simple (BarChart, AreaChart).
PAGES: Create a Landing Page, Dashboard, Account Connection Page, and Campaign Creator.
TESTING: Add data-testid to every button, input, and link.
universal_guidelines: Create depth through subtle borders, not heavy shadows.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters.
